entry.question:
## Physical scenario

A cylindrical shell with radius \( R_1 \) and height \( H \) has charge \( Q_1 \) and rotates around its axis with angular speed \( \omega_1 \). Inside the cylinder, far from its edges, sits a very small disk with radius \( R_2 \), mass \( M \), and charge \( Q_2 \) mounted on a pivot, spinning with a large angular velocity \( \vec{\omega}_2 \) and oriented at angle \( \theta \) with respect to the axis of the cylinder. The center of the disk is on the axis of the cylinder. The magnetic interaction between the cylinder and the disk causes a precession of the axis of the disk.

## Question

The magnetic moment of the disk has magnitude \( \mu = \frac{1}{4} Q_2 \omega_2 R_2^2 \). What is the magnitude of the torque exerted on the disk?

## Answer choices

- A: A: \frac{\mu_0 Q_1 Q_2 \omega_1 \omega_2 R_2 \sin \theta}{8 \pi H}

- B: B: \frac{\mu_0 Q_1 Q_2 \omega_1 \omega_2 R_2^2 \sin \theta}{8 \pi H}

- C: C: \frac{\mu_0 Q_1 Q_2 \omega_1 \omega_2 R_2^2 \cos \theta}{8 \pi H}

- D: D: \frac{\mu_0 Q_1 Q_2 \omega_1 \omega_2 R_2^2}{8 \pi H}
